content.value: Material scientists work with diverse types of materials that have different melting points. (10) We are going to design a class namely 'Material' to store the name and melting point of various materials. Now,
i) Design a parameterized constructor whose role is to initialize the name and melting point of different materials.
ii) Create a function that calculates and displays the average melting point of two materials when objects of the 'Material' class are passed to it.

_source_title: B.Sc. Engineering 2nd Year 2nd Term Regular Examination, 2020
